title: My Cousin Chloe
hook: 大表姐克洛伊来做客，她玩的游戏规则太多，佩奇玩不过她，最后还是泥坑最好玩。

cells.q: What are Peppa and George doing?
cells.a: They are playing in the garden at home.

cells.q: Who came to spend the day at Peppa's house?
cells.a: Their big cousin Chloe came to spend the day.
cells.cn: 他们的表姐克洛伊来家里玩一天。

cells.q: What game did Chloe ask about?
cells.a: She asked if they still play the game Catch.
cells.cn: 她问他们还玩不玩“抓人”游戏。

cells.a: She asked Peppa if she wants her to help.
cells.cn: 她问佩奇要不要她帮忙。

cells.q: What did Peppa think of the game?
cells.a: She said it is a silly game and wanted another one.
cells.cn: 她说这游戏太傻了，想换一个。

cells.q: What did Peppa say to Chloe?
cells.a: She said, “You moved before I was ready!”
cells.cn: 她说：“我还没准备好你就动了！”

cells.q: What did Chloe say about the rules?
cells.a: She said the rules let her look as long as she wants.
cells.cn: 她说规则允许她想看多久就看多久。

cells.a: Jumping up and down in muddy puddles is her favourite.
cells.cn: 她最喜欢在泥坑里跳来跳去。

cells.q: What did the whole family do at the end?
cells.a: They all jumped up and down in muddy puddles together.
cells.cn: 全家人一起在泥坑里跳来跳去。

ending: In the end, everyone jumps in muddy puddles. My favourite part is ______.
